name: Homepage
author: gethomepage
description: A second dashboard for this box, configured entirely in YAML: tiles, live status dots and header widgets, edited in ~/services/homepage/config and reloaded without a restart. It overlaps this launcher on purpose — Homepage is the nicer read-only front door, while the launcher is the only one that can deploy, start and stop things. They share no code and neither knows the other exists, so a service added to one will not appear in the other. Runs on host networking because every service here binds 127.0.0.1: from a bridge network its health probes reach nothing and every tile is a dead link. Its own socket still binds loopback only. No login — the tailnet is the access control, same as code-server.

control._comment: Single container, config on a bind mount; nothing to order.
